mapper.select: SELECT FROM bike_file_upload WHERE object_key=#{key} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bike_production_attachment WHERE object_key=#{key}) + EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bike_pi_confirmation_attachment WHERE object_key=#{key}) + EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bike_pi_payment_attachment WHERE object_key=#{key}) + EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bike_pi_logistics_attachment WHERE object_key=#{key}) + EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bike_after_sales_attachment WHERE object_key=#{key}) + EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bike_pi_export WHERE pdf_key=#{key} OR xlsx_key=#{key}) + EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bike_pi_payment WHERE voucher_object_key=#{key})
mapper.update: UPDATE bike_file_upload SET state='BOUND',object_state='PRESENT',version=version+1,updated_at=NOW(3),error_code=NULL WHERE object_key=#{key} AND state='PENDING'
UPDATE bike_file_upload SET state='REVIEW',version=version+1,updated_at=NOW(3),error_code='UPLOAD_OR_BIND_FAILED' WHERE object_key=#{key} AND state='PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT FROM bike_file_upload ORDER BY created_at DESC,object_key DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT object_key FROM bike_file_upload WHERE (state='PENDING' AND created_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(3),INTERVAL 15 MINUTE)) OR (state='CLEANUP_PENDING' AND updated_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(3),INTERVAL 1 MINUTE)) ORDER BY updated_at,object_key LIMIT 20

SELECT id,action,before_state beforeState,after_state afterState,before_version beforeVersion,reason,operator_name operatorName,created_at createdAt FROM bike_file_upload_review WHERE object_key=#{key} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 100
